title: Resumable long-running goals and user-controlled proactive assistance
whatBuilt: RESUMABLE GOALS: append-only events + periodic CHECKPOINT; resume replays to an identical state (restart/interruption recovery proven); LEASE bounds concurrent workers — lease-race denied, stale leases re-acquirable; only the leaseholder advances; progress deterministic
CANCEL: owner-only; stops advancement and leasing immediately

USER-CONTROLLED PROACTIVE ASSISTANCE: explicit per-category OPT-IN (nothing delivered by default — no default unsolicited messages); opt-out takes effect immediately; QUIET HOURS honored incl. overnight windows; dismissed suggestions never resurface; per-day frequency cap; every delivered suggestion gets a REAL receipt with a test identity
SUGGEST-ONLY: proactive suggestions never execute; actions require explicit per-action consent (executed stays false); NO always-on microphone

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 218/218 pass (208 previous + 10 longgoals)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The scheduler/lease/notification receipts are the CONTRACT plane; wiring into the existing backend scheduler and real notification delivery remains integration work. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
